questions.context: Grade Pre-2 6 Old Friends Ruby, a college student who lives in New York, is from a small town. She is usually very busy with her studies. And during college vacations, she often stays in the city to spend time with her college friends. One day, she returned to her hometown for the first time in a while. (21), she found out that her childhood friend Alfred's house was no longer there. Later, she heard that his whole family had recently moved out. Ruby and Alfred were childhood friends but had little contact with each other. Ruby felt bad about it, so she decided to contact him to meet. When they met, they (22). They had not seen each other for a long time but did not feel uncomfortable at all. This experience made her realize that her childhood friends were a big part of her life. She also learned that she should care more about her old friends.
